parameters.query:
SELECT
  ch.business_id,
  ch.numero,
  ch.updated_at,
  ch.inactividad_estado,
  ch.messages::text,
  b.whatsapp_instance AS instance,
  b.owner_number,
  b.schedule_text::text,
  b.timezone
FROM conversation_history ch
JOIN businesses b ON b.id = ch.business_id
WHERE ch.updated_at < NOW() - '15 minutes'::interval
  AND b.active = true
  AND (ch.inactividad_estado IS NULL OR ch.inactividad_estado = 'avisado')
ORDER BY ch.updated_at ASC

UPDATE conversation_history
SET inactividad_estado = 'avisado'
WHERE business_id = $1
  AND numero = $2
  AND (inactividad_estado IS NULL OR inactividad_estado = '');

UPDATE conversation_history
SET inactividad_estado = 'cerrado'
WHERE business_id = $1
  AND numero = $2
  AND inactividad_estado = 'avisado';
